[[File:NuteGunray-NEGTC.png|thumb|180px|[[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]]]
{{Quote|Cut off the head, and the serpent dies. Without the viceroy, the Trade Federation collapses.|Padmé Amidala|<ref name="TPM">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''Viceroy of the Trade Federation''', sometimes referred to as the '''Trade Federation Viceroy''' or '''Commanding Viceroy''', was the [[Guild Master/Legends|leader]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the chairbeing of the [[Trade Federation Directorate]], and, as a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]], head of the [[Neimoidian Inner Circle]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. The symbol of the Viceroy around the time of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was a three-pointed tiara, but it would change over time. The Viceroy also held absolute control over the Trade Federation as well as the Neimoidians, the latter due to operating under a [[Neimoidian communal hive|hive mind]], being unable to think for themselves. Because of this, were the Viceroy either killed or otherwise incapacitated, the Neimoidians and Trade Federation would cease any operations. This was especially prevalent during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion]] and later [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|liberation]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where Queen Amidala effectively ended the war by forcing Nute Gunray into signing a new treaty.

[[Hask]] was the Viceroy as of [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]. He was succeeded by [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], who held the position until [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|his]] [[Death/Legends|demise]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. [[Sentepeth Findos]] served as Acting Viceroy very briefly following Gunray's death, until the Federation was nationalized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order]] where he and the Federation would-be a puppet to the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], however, he would remain the leader of the Trade Federation until it was [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolved]] with the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

During the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Federation's]] militarization, the Viceroy acted as [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of their [[Trade Defense Force|military]].

[[Nute Gunray/Legends|Gunray]], as Viceroy, assumed control of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Federation's occupation of the planet]], temporarily replacing the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch]], [[Governor/Legends|Governor]], and captain of Security.
